status: current commercial offer; channel availability and release readiness are documented separately
taxNote: Totals in Australian dollars; if GST applies it is included and the receipt states the exact treatment.

freeMonths.activationMeans: the subscription is created: in the app through the App Store, or by the studio for an invoiced account; card payment on the website is coming later (the website card-on-file trial is built in Square Sandbox and opens with the card lane)
freeMonths.websiteCardPayment: Square card on file for the website trial and card plans; Sandbox until the owner opens the card lane
freeMonths.paymentSetup: App Store payment arrangement in the app, or written studio invoice terms; on the website, card entry happens only in Square's own card field on the account page, which is Square Sandbox until the card lane opens
freeMonths.renewalNotice: Check the renewal date in your account and Apple subscription settings; Veylet email reminders are not yet operational
freeMonths.morePacks: walkthrough packs can be bought during the free months on the website; the free-months end date stays the same
freeMonths.earlyPaidSwitchNote: an App Store free trial cannot be switched to paid early; the website members' annual 'start today' option (membersAnnual.startNow) is a separate card plan and only applies when no paid period would overlap
freeMonths.verification: one trial per agency (ABN) and workspace; the app unlocks real captures once the practice room passes (checked in the app, not yet enforced on the server)
freeMonths.reminderStatus: planned: reminder email 7 days before the first charge (not yet operational)

cardOnFile.appStore: Apple's 3-month free introductory offer (a payment method on the Apple Account is required)
cardOnFile.web: Square card on file at trial start; the first charge is scheduled for the day the free months end (Square Sandbox until the card lane opens)
cardOnFile.invoice: an agreed paid start date in writing

plans.name: Veylet plan
plans.annualRule: 24 walkthroughs to use any time in the plan year (a yearly pool); website or invoice A$990, App Store A$1,199.99; 2 months free
plans.role: the one plan: 2 walkthroughs a month with rollover, or annual with a 24-walkthrough yearly pool
plans.hostingRule: every released tour stays live while the account has a running plan (free months, monthly or annual), and in any case for at least 12 months after its release; after both, A$49 per tour per further year on request

rollover.rule: unused monthly walkthroughs carry over, up to 4 banked at any time

founding.name: Founding agencies
founding.price: the normal Veylet plan and pack prices; no special or locked price
perks: a free 3-pack for each referred office that becomes a paying account (up to four)
a direct line to the founder
founding.accountFlag: a programme flag on the account, not a plan code; the retired plan code 'founding' only describes older rows

appStore.program: 15% is a modelling assumption; programme enrolment is not verified
appStore.pricingRule: Separate published App Store and studio invoice totals; do not infer exact net revenue from the commission assumption
appStore.annualNote: The App Store sells the Veylet plan monthly (dev.property3d.capture.solo.monthly, A$119.99) and annual (dev.property3d.capture.solo.annual, A$1,199.99), both with a 3-month free introductory offer. Express renders and packs are not sold in the app. The Team monthly and annual products stay off sale; a verified notification for any of them still maps to its plan.

counting.acceptedMeans: the automatic quality check passed and the workspace approved the exact revision for release
counting.rolloverRule: monthly plan: unused included walkthroughs bank, at most 4; annual plan: a 24-walkthrough yearly pool with no rollover between plan years; free months: 6 in total
counting.largeHomeRule: see walkthroughScope.countsAsTwo; declared at new listing and locked when capture starts

devices: iPhone 12 Pro and later Pro or Pro Max models

membersAnnual.status: the public annual price (offer 2026-09-25.2); the website card switch flow (Apple renewal off, scheduled start) is kept for App Store members moving to the website annual

unlock.checkedBy: server, before any checkout or invoice

membersAnnual.visibility: annual is public on /offer, in the account and in the app (App Store price only in the app)
membersAnnual.tierRule: one public annual price; scheduled or active annual plans keep the price they were bought at
membersAnnual.switchFromAppStore: the member turns off App Store renewal themselves; the annual card plan starts when the App Store paid period or the free months end; if App Store renewal is turned back on before the start, the scheduled start is paused so nobody pays twice
membersAnnual.startNow: the member can start today instead once the free-months walkthroughs are used up and no paid period would overlap

retiredPlans.rule: not sold to new accounts from offer 2026-09-24.2; existing verified or agreed rows keep their terms and map as before

packRules.availableTo: any activated account: during the free months or on the plan
packRules.usedAfter: the free-months, monthly (including banked) or annual-pool included walkthroughs
packRules.expires: 12 months after purchase; unused walkthroughs are not refunded after that

channels.web: Square card on /account (Sandbox until the card lane opens) or studio invoice
channels.app: in-app purchase arrives in a later app version

packRules.unit: one accepted walkthrough per pack walkthrough; a capture that is not good enough uses none

earlyAnnualBonus.rule: choose annual before the free months end: +4 walkthroughs and 4 Super fast renders in the first plan year (Super fast renders are used on the website)

referral.rule: when a referred office becomes a paying account, both offices get 1 bonus walkthrough; the referrer shares their own link

walkthroughScope.unit: one visit to the interior rooms of one home
walkthroughScope.countsAsTwo: 5 or more bedrooms, a second dwelling, or more than 350 m² of floor area
walkthroughScope.declaredAt: new listing; the count locks when capture starts

expressRender.promise: rendered on the fastest GPU available in Australia and first in the queue: ready in about 30 minutes, any day, any time, or the A$29 is refunded automatically
expressRender.refund: if it isn't ready for review within 30 minutes of the upload finishing, the A$29 is refunded automatically (a used credit is returned)
expressRender.name: Super fast render

anchor.text: A photographer's 3D tour costs A$215–400 each

guarantee.text: If your first walkthrough isn't listing-ready, we redo it free
guarantee.scope: the account's first accepted walkthrough; the redo is a correction revision (no unit, same link); a recapture visit is not included

processing.turnaround: usually within 1–2 hours of the upload finishing; no person checks it
processing.qualityGate: an automatic quality check (held-out photo match, coverage, floaters, walkable paths, plus an AI visual check once the privacy notice covers it) must pass before the walkthrough appears; otherwise it retries once, then asks for a recapture of the named rooms
processing.approval: the account reviews and approves before sharing
